git add bot/missing/src/missing.ts && git commit -F - <<'EOF'
fix(missing): tolerate messages without a streams array

The batch-end marker on twitch-stats-streams carries only endConfig, so
update() received undefined and threw a TypeError outside the consumer's
try block. kafkajs stopped the consumer while the process stayed alive,
leaving the pod 1/1 Running with 0 restarts and 1.4M messages of lag.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01V8szurPzWknURufYMXZmDk
EOF
